claim_boundary: This amendment closes the visual-producer ambiguity before selected raw payload access. It is protocol and contract infrastructure, not observation-quality, physical-prediction, calibration, safety, state-of-the-art, or Causal4D evidence.
rationale: The parent protocol fixes persistent visual identities and complete joint gauge semantics but does not yet bind one exact Prob4D revision, MotionCrafter model set, seed policy, window geometry, storage mode, initial metric-frame prior, or additional-anchor policy. Those choices can materially change the visual arm and must be frozen without target access.
stage_order: merge this target-blind amendment and lock-contract implementation
create and commit one exact visual-provider lock before downloading selected calibration payloads
freeze the deployed predictor, score, guard, grouping rule, and endpoint set from external or source-only evidence before interval-calibration scores are inspected
download and process calibration objects only
create and commit one exact calibration lock before opening confirmation payloads
open confirmation payloads exactly once and publish the registered positive or negative result
